name: Logan Hamm
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I still remember a supervisor quietly offering me the better view.” On Thursday, near the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, Logan notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I got teased for being sentimental. My foreman quietly gave me his lunch break to watch.
appearance: Logan is easy to recognize by auburn hair cut square at the nape and a narrow face with an expressive upper lip. Usually dressed in a faded indigo overshirt with a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges, Logan grins on one side while the eyes stay serious when listening.
personality: Logan always notices who paid for the last round. In a group that can be a kindness or a small tyranny, and Logan is trying to tell the difference before the bill arrives.
agenda: To thank the foreman who made time.
family: Allen Baker is Logan’s older cousin. Logan puts the kettle on. Allen chooses the music. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The new language at dinner*, Allen says, “I have recordings of him telling jokes before his stroke.”
connections: Devin Jeong. A break granted to the watcher lets the painter mend the scrubbed wing.
